changelog:
flight-baggage-check v1.0.0

- Initial release.
- Provides precise, three-section baggage compliance reports based on airline/authority rules.
- Supports detailed handling of overweight, excess baggage, and special/regulated items.
- Requires official rule screenshots for every report.
- All outputs in simplified Chinese, with strict template and fact-checking requirements.
- Integrates with price and rules services (flyai/flight-helper) for real-time cost verification.
